text:
kai-finance: Payment alert: Neon Health (acct: neon-inc) invoice INV-5421 failed on card auth. Processor message: 'card_declined' (code 402). AVS mismatch, and card flagged as 3DS-required. I tried /payments retry INV-5421 -> still declined. Customer asked about ACH or wire as a fallback. tagging ops for next steps.

payments-bot: Automated note: 1 retry attempted at 2026-03-15 14:12 UTC, last response: card_declined. Invoice locked for auto-retry until 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC.

sam-payments: Can you paste the raw decline code from the processor response? Need to know if it's soft decline vs permanent. Also is the token still valid or expired? If it's just 3DS we can send a secure update link to have them re-auth the card.

lily-cs: Customer says procurement wants wire asap — they have month-end close on Mon. They've shared bank details in a private thread. We should confirm AML/KYC before giving our wire details.

emma-accounting: We can accept a wire, but ops needs: PO, vendor onboarding form, and basic KYC (company reg + proof of account). Also confirm remit address and billing contact. I can take the PO if it's uploaded.

ryan-sales: I can ping the buyer and ask them to upload the PO + a bank letter. They prefer wire over ACH (international payer). I'll press for same-day docs.

sam-payments: Proposed ops checklist: 1) Verify PO & KYC (Emma) 2) Enable manual 'Wire' payment method on INV-5421 in Billing UI (Sam) 3) Send wire instructions template to customer once KYC confirmed (Lily) 4) Mark invoice as 'pending manual payment' and set reconciliation reminder (Sam). Any objections?

lily-cs: +1. Email template below — I'll wait for Emma to confirm KYC before sending.

lily-cs: ```
Subject: Wire instructions for Redwood invoice INV-5421

Hi <Name>,

Thanks — we can accept payment via wire. Please reference INV-5421 on the transfer. Our high-level instructions:
- Bank name: Redwood Financial Services (placeholder)
- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- SWIFT/BIC: [will provide after KYC]
- Account number / IBAN: [will provide after KYC]

Required docs to proceed: PO, company registration, and proof of bank account (bank letter or recent statement). Once we receive those and confirm the wire, we'll mark the invoice paid and issue a receipt.

If you need intermediary bank info, let us know.

Best,
Redwood Billing
```

emma-accounting: Confirmed — PO found in support ticket #3821 and amount matches INV-5421. KYC doc missing (company reg). I'll send a KYC request today and copy Sales.

sam-payments: After KYC is in, I'll enable the wire option and unlock the invoice for manual payment. Command I'll run: `/billing set-method INV-5421 wire` and then set a reconciliation reminder.

kai-finance: Thanks all. Action owners: Emma (KYC & confirm PO), Sam (enable wire + reconcile), Lily (customer comms + send template), Ryan (follow up with buyer). Please update this thread when each step is done. :v:
